why: THE RECON APPLIED, BRACKET 4 BY THE PILOT'S CALL (deck_recon.json, 2026-09-10, EDHREC's 3,924 pair decks). The kill: Curiosity, Ophidian Eye and Tandem Lookout on Brallin, which with Niv-Mizzet Parun and Glint-Horn Buccaneer already in is three two-card infinites -- hence bracket 4. Interaction 4 -> 12 (Swords, Path, Counterspell, Veto, Arcane Denial, Blasphemous Act, Chaos Warp, Rift, Boros Charm, Teferi's Protection). Seven surplus wheels and the Puzzle Box out for the loot suite the consensus runs (Frantic Search, Thrill, Cathartic Reunion, Brainstorm); eight wheels stay. The builder's 17 off-map picks out for the discard payoffs (Captain Howler, Marauding Mako, Ghostly Pilferer), Teferi's Ageless Insight, Thought Vessel, three two-mana rocks and Ojer Axonil. The builder's twelve coverage-chosen lands out for the cycling-land package; 35 lands. THE GOLDFISH READS THE SHARK HALF ONLY: Brallin's discard trigger has no channel, and a wheel that says 'draws that many' is not 'draw N', so the draw axis (0.632 extra cards by T8 on v0.1.0) is a proxy that sees the loots and the draw engines. Forge at standard-v3 is the verdict.
